title: SwitchBot Hub 4 Smart Home controller supports Matter 1.3, Hello Kata voice control, over 101,000 infrared devices

content:
SwitchBot Hub 4 is a Smart Home control hub with a color display, physical controls (buttons and knob), Hello Kata voice control, WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity, and Matter Bridge 1.3 support. It supports over 101,000 infrared appliances, including air conditioners, televisions, projectors, fans, streaming devices (Fire TV, Apple TV, and Android TV), and more. For devices that are not part of the list, you can also use the IR learning function. The hub can also control Bluetooth HID devices, SwitchBot devices, and Matter devices via on-screen touch shortcuts and the rotary knob. SwitchBot Hub 4 (W108021000) specifications: SoC – Not specified. Potentially ESP32-S3. Display 2.8-inch IPS color LCD with 240 x 320 resolution Bottom touch area Shows time, weather, temperature/humidity, device status, and scene/shortcut entries Audio 2W full-range speaker 2x omnidirectional microphones Voice wake-up with “Hello Kata” within a 3 m range Voice control for devices, alarm creation, and calendar [...]
